note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Accept only the same geographic entity: own time-filtered P31/P131 and official codes, current type/type_local, parent and state, original point inside the raw official own polygon, and agreement of source scope. HU uses own unique five-digit P939 in the 2026 Helysegnevtar whole-locality table; match its first four digits to the public KSH locality polygon and verify official name/county/district. SI uses the six-digit settlement, never its three-digit municipality total, in 05C5003S at 1 January 2026; own P131 equals the existing municipality state and GURS settlement code/name agree. Hold GURS records modified after reference day. RS uses own settlement 2022 census count from the RZS GeoCensus feature, independently checked against a settlement-level workbook row; own P131 and existing parent or unique existing administrative parent bind the same official municipality and state. Verify the official municipality-to-area code against the own census district polygon, the Serbian district label against the existing ISO state, and both original place and existing state points inside that district. Hold source hierarchy conflicts and state-point conflicts. Hold municipal rows because latest own 2025 estimate and geometry have not been bound. Unresolved keys remain unchanged unless original v4 entity continuity is proved with a reviewed changed-row event; none is asserted here. CY requires government-controlled 2021 same-entity historical scope; current reform polygons do not establish that scope. Never guess a missing item, parent, unit, source count or reference year.
